rules.blank_state: The public template has no observations and no measured plan or summary values.
rules.url_sanitization: Accept only HTTP(S) URLs on the predeclared origin and exact predeclared capability-free safe paths. Remove credentials, query strings, and fragments; replace every unapproved or dynamic path with /[redacted-path] while preserving its actual HTTP(S) origin.
rules.exit_sanitization: Keep raw exit IP evidence outside the worksheet. Store only a non-reversible reference controlled by the evidence owner.
rules.failure_retention: Keep navigation failures as observations with success false and a bounded failure_code; never copy raw exception text.
rules.success_evaluation: Evaluate every configured success_rule condition, require a verified globally routable IPv4 exit reference, and require observed country to match a declared country selector. HTTP status alone is insufficient.
rules.challenge_rate: Divide observed challenges only by challenge-tested observations. Report challenge-test coverage separately.
rules.selector_window: Optional selectors use settling_window_ms plus the recorded selector_observation_window_ms and distinguish not_observed from not_tested. Target selectors are not tested after navigation failure.
rules.screenshot_reference: Capture only after successful target navigation into a caller-supplied absolute private directory outside the current workspace, with restrictive permissions. Set a unique nullable non-public reference only after capture succeeds; do not embed screenshot data or a public URL.
rules.route_metadata: Declare a validated route_origin and route_selector before collection. Requested and observed countries must belong to the explicit ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 set; use unknown when no supported selector is confirmed.

csv_serialization.nested_values: Serialize objects and arrays with JSON.stringify before CSV escaping.
csv_serialization.null_values: Serialize null as an empty field.
csv_serialization.formula_safety: Prefix values beginning with =, +, -, or @ with a single quote before CSV escaping.
csv_serialization.escaping: Wrap fields containing commas, quotes, CR, or LF in double quotes and double each embedded quote.

prohibited_values: Screenshot bytes or public screenshot URLs
Unredacted query strings or URL fragments
